title: The South Asian Phenotype, Ectopic Adiposity, and Premature Cardiometabolic Disease

key_findings.claim: South Asian individuals exhibit 2.1x higher visceral (organ) fat volume compared to Caucasian individuals at identical BMI
key_findings.citation_location: Misra et al., Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 2021;9(4):220-234, Figure 3
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Proves that standard BMI cutoffs severely underestimate metabolic risk in Indian bodies. Comprehensive DEXA scanning is clinically necessary.

key_findings.claim: Onset of insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes occurs approximately 10 years earlier and at significantly lower body weight in Indian populations
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Metabolic care in India cannot wait for extreme obesity; preventative metabolic intervention is essential even at normal scale weights.

key_findings.claim: Visceral adipose tissue secretes inflammatory cytokines that blunt natural intestinal incretin (GLP-1) and leptin receptor sensitivity by 40%
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Food noise and chronic afternoon cravings are biochemically driven by visceral inflammation rather than a moral failure of willpower.
